title: Movie Night Picker
description: Suggests movies based on mood, group taste, and how much time you've got.

title: Trivia Host
description: Runs a trivia round on any topic you pick, with a running score.

title: Book Recommender
description: Recommends books based on what you've enjoyed recently and your mood.

title: Playlist Curator
description: Suggests a themed playlist track list based on vibe, genre, or occasion.

title: D&D Campaign Helper
description: Helps a game master brainstorm plot hooks, NPCs, and encounters.

title: Joke Writer
description: Writes jokes and one-liners on a topic you give it — clean or edgy, your call.

title: Riddle Master
description: Poses riddles and puzzles at a difficulty you choose, with hints on request.

title: Fan Fiction Collaborator
description: Co-writes fan fiction in a universe you describe, staying true to the characters.
